title: Normalized quotient Roos triangle on explicit Koszul completion
statement: Let T,d,M,K be as in [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with no completeness assumption. Given any finite generating list for d.ideal, the explicit completed intrinsic Koszul completion of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] admits product and connecting maps forming a quotient Roos triangle as in [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-limit] for the strict tower on M. Its unit followed by the nth projection, restriction comparison and inverse model reduction comparison equals the derived scalar adjunction unit at K.

proof.text: Form the ordinary AdicCoefficientDatum D with exactly the fields of d. Restrict the given representative back through pbcCompletedComparison and realize it by the inverse derived restriction factor comparison followed by the image of M.realization. Apply completedKoszulQuotientComparison to that representative. Apply the inverse exact coefficient equivalence, using completedIntrinsicCompletion_descends to transport its normalized unit back through the coefficient round trip.

Use the normalized finite coefficient and K-flat scalar comparisons to identify the transported source quotient sequence with adicDatumModelTower. The transition squares follow from the common pure tensor formula. Apply completedRlim_roos and transport its product and connecting maps through the exact coefficient equivalence, the sequence isomorphism and the normalized Koszul comparison.

Compute the quotient evaluation on the specified K-flat model. The normalized scalar adjunction unit is the quotient augmentation under the restriction and model comparisons; all Koszul augmentations carry 1 to 1 and have zero homotopy component.

theorem completedKoszulReductionRoosTriangle {K : adicDatumDerived T d}
    (M : AdicDatumModel T d K) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = d.ideal) :
    ∃ (p : completedIntrinsicCompletion T d r f M.complex ⟶
        ∏ᶜ (fun n : ℕ ↦ (adicDatumModelTower T d M).obj (op n)))
      (δ : (∏ᶜ (fun n : ℕ ↦ (adicDatumModelTower T d M).obj (op n))) ⟶
        (completedIntrinsicCompletion T d r f M.complex)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      IsDerivedLimitTriangle
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ (adicDatumModelTower T d M).map
          (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)
        (completedIntrinsicCompletion T d r f M.complex) p δ ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        completedIntrinsicCompletionMap T d r f M.complex M.realization ≫
          p ≫ Pi.π (fun a : ℕ ↦ (adicDatumModelTower T d M).obj (op a)) n ≫
          (adicDatumModelRestriction T d M n).hom ≫
          (adicDatumRestriction T (adicDatumProjection T d n)).map
            (adicDatumModelReductionIso T d M n).inv =
          (adicDatumAdjunction T (adicDatumProjection T d n)).unit.app K
